skills.name: PMaaS
skills.author: goyalsandeep2k
skills.description: Convert raw engineering updates, sprint chaos, and Jira noise into structured stakeholder-ready program management artifacts — instantly.
skills.longDescription: PMaaS transforms the way teams manage programs. Drop in raw standup notes, Jira exports, or Slack threads and get back a polished status dashboard, risk register, dependency map, and executive brief in seconds. Designed for TPMs, EMs, and program owners who spend more time formatting reports than actually shipping. Works with any input format — raw bullet points, copy-pasted Slack, or JIRA CSV exports.

skills.name: PRD Generator
skills.author: goyalsandeep2k
skills.description: Takes validation outputs, discovery notes, or rough ideas and structures a production-ready PRD with user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
skills.longDescription: Stop writing PRDs from scratch. Feed this skill your discovery notes, user research findings, or a raw problem statement — it outputs a complete, stakeholder-approved PRD with measurable outcomes, edge cases, technical constraints, and every section a PM needs to ship with confidence. Generates user stories, acceptance criteria, out-of-scope items, and success metrics automatically.

skills.name: Meeting Prep
skills.author: goyalsandeep2k
skills.description: Generate pre-meeting briefs and extract clean, owner-assigned, time-bound action items from any transcript, notes, or Slack thread.
skills.longDescription: Walk into every meeting prepared. Walk out with zero dropped balls. This skill handles both modes: pre-meeting briefing (pulls context from docs, Jira, Slack) and post-meeting triage (extracts decisions, action items with owners, open questions, and parking lot items from any raw transcript). Works with Zoom summaries, Otter.ai transcripts, Google Meet notes, or rough handwritten bullet points.

skills.name: Exec Status
skills.author: goyalsandeep2k
skills.description: Translate verbose engineering updates into crisp red/yellow/green executive status reports your VP will actually read — in under 90 seconds.
skills.longDescription: Your VP has 90 seconds. This skill has your back. Feed it standup notes, Jira exports, or Slack threads and get back a one-page exec brief with a clear health signal, this week's wins, top risks (honest, not sanitized), decisions needed from leadership, and concrete asks. No jargon. No buried lede. No sugarcoating bad news. Built by a Head of TPM who's written hundreds of these.

skills.name: Dep & Risk Tracker
skills.author: goyalsandeep2k
skills.description: Analyze project timelines, flag critical path items, map cross-team dependencies, and generate a full RAID log with mitigation strategies.
skills.longDescription: The skill that finds the landmines before they blow up your launch. Feed it a project plan, epic list, team org chart, or dependency matrix — get back a full RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) with owners, timelines, severity ratings, and mitigation playbooks. Automatically identifies the critical path and surfaces hidden blockers that would otherwise slip through standup.
